title: Level-One Fourier Weight
statement: For a function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, its Fourier weight at level one is the sum of the squares of its singleton Fourier coefficients: $W_1(f)=\sum_{i=1}^n \widehat f(\{i\})^2$.
